catalyst_summary: Brookfield India Real Estate Trust commands the highest constituent weight in the Nifty REITs & Realty Index at 15.80%, maintaining an industry-leading distribution yield of 6.27%, a robust 6.7-year WALE, and 93.0% occupancy across its 5-city institutional Grade-A office portfolio in Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Kolkata.

Embassy Office Parks REIT represents 14.48% of the Nifty REITs & Realty Index, maintaining the longest portfolio WALE among all Indian office REITs at 8.4 years. Supported by 90.0% occupancy and a 5.77% distribution yield across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Noida, and Chennai, its multi-year lease tenure provides superior cash-flow visibility.

Nexus Select Trust accounts for 13.65% of the Nifty REITs & Realty Index as India's sole listed retail REIT. It commands a stellar 96.0% portfolio occupancy and a 5.41% distribution yield across 17 marquee consumption centers in 15 cities, leveraging a 4.5-year WALE with dynamic minimum guarantee and turnover rent escalations.

Mindspace Business Parks REIT holds a 7.42% allocation in the Nifty REITs & Realty Index, operating with a 7.2-year WALE, 90.7% committed occupancy, and a 5.60% distribution yield across prime micro-markets in Mumbai Metropolitan Region, Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai.

Knowledge Realty Trust comprises 7.26% of the Nifty REITs & Realty Index following its marquee August 2025 listing. Sponsored by Sattva Group and Blackstone, it maintains a lengthy 7.9-year WALE, 93.0% occupancy, and a 4.90%+ initial distribution yield across 46.3 msf spanning Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Gurugram, and GIFT City.

DLF Limited commands the largest builder allocation in the Nifty REITs & Realty Index at 8.20%, capitalizing on unprecedented super-luxury housing pre-sales velocity in Gurugram alongside its blue-chip DCCDL CyberCity commercial rental cash-flow stream.

moat_vectors.positional: Uncontested campus monopoly in East Bengaluru's Outer Ring Road (ORR) and CV Raman Nagar tech belts, housing mission-critical mega-GCCs across contiguous multi-million sq ft blocks.
moat_vectors.product: Industry-leading operational metrics; commands an exceptional 98.7% occupancy rate—the highest among all 6 Indian REITs—with high power redundancy, captive solar integration, and high tenant retention.
moat_vectors.technological: Integrated green tech parks powered by captive solar assets, advanced water treatment plants, and smart-campus energy management platforms.
moat_vectors.governance: Disciplined Holdco/SPV leverage under SEBI REIT guidelines, maintaining high NOI conversion (~89%) and transparent quarterly dividend distributions.

semantic_text: Bagmane Prime Office REIT is India's sixth listed real estate investment trust, listed in May 2026 with a pure-play concentration in Bengaluru's Grade-A tech office market. Sponsored by the Bagmane Group, its completed ~16.7 msf portfolio encompasses landmark assets including Bagmane World Technology Centre (BWTC) and Bagmane Constellation. It boasts the highest occupancy among all Indian REITs at 98.7%, a robust WALE of 7.1 years, and an estimated distribution yield of 5.50%+, serving world-scale GCC tenants like Google, Amazon, and Boeing.

moat_vectors.positional: Unrivaled brand trust and consumer pull of the Aditya Birla conglomerate, enabling rapid pre-sales velocity and premium pricing realizations across Worli (Birla Niyaara), NCR, and Bengaluru.
moat_vectors.product: Architectural excellence focused on wellness and biophilic design ('LifeDesigned' concept); portfolio features marquee luxury skyscrapers in South Mumbai and master-planned townships in Bengaluru.
moat_vectors.technological: Modern precast and aluminium formwork construction methods reducing gestation timelines; centralized BIM digital project monitoring.
moat_vectors.governance: Blue-chip Aditya Birla Group corporate governance; conservative balance-sheet gearing, institutional debt pricing parity with AAA peers, and rapid capital rotation.

semantic_text: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (formerly Century Textiles and Industries Limited) is the real estate development flagship of the Aditya Birla Group, operating under the premier 'Birla Estates' brand. With a 1.31% weight in the Nifty REITs & Realty Total Return Index, ABREL develops high-end residential communities and Grade-A commercial office spaces across MMR, NCR, Bengaluru, and Pune. Anchored by iconic projects like Birla Niyaara in Worli, ABREL unlocks prime internal land parcels and executes capital-efficient JDAs backed by the Aditya Birla Group's elite credit rating and brand pedigree.
